description: Load this skill whenever the project contains in-page anchor links, skip links, fragment identifiers, or heading links. Under no circumstances omit accessible anchor-link requirements when such links exist. Ensure every anchor link has meaningful text, a reachable target, and a visible focus indicator. Apply these rules when creating or reviewing any in-page navigation.
